name: Computronium
detailed_description:
Computronium is all about building large scale computer networks from the ground up.

As a new remote hire for a shadowy solar-system-wide corporation, your task is to consume and host data, provide large amounts of computational horsepower, and protect your assets from outside harm. Climb the corporate ladder and discover why the corporation has access to impossibly advanced technologies.

  • Build your data center and chip fab

  • Upgrade and plan your network

  • Defend against cyberattacks and drone swarms

  • Unlock new abilities and technologies

  • Cooperate with your friends and NPC co-workers

  • Compete with ruthless NPC managers and factions

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5-3570 3.4 GHz 4 Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650/GTX 1050-ti, or AMD RX 470/RX 570, or equivalent performance & VRAM
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for multiplayer.
